invariants.statement: Every fact has one authoritative owner, and every semantic behavior has one canonical implementation path.
invariants.activates_when: always

invariants.statement: Modules expose small intentional contracts; storage, provider, and framework internals remain behind their owners.
invariants.activates_when: a module or process boundary exists

invariants.statement: Shared product semantics live below every UI, API, worker, assistant, and backend; differences live in adapters.
invariants.activates_when: two surfaces implement the same product behavior

invariants.statement: Assembly occurs in an explicit composition root rather than ambient globals or route construction.
invariants.activates_when: a system has replaceable dependencies or multiple adapters

invariants.statement: When accepted user intent must survive the caller, successful admission means that intent is already durable.
invariants.activates_when: work may outlive a request, route, process, or device opportunity

invariants.statement: Retries, duplicates, timeouts, cancellation, interruption, and process death are defined execution paths.
invariants.activates_when: work crosses a temporal or process boundary

invariants.statement: Events come from committed facts; durable consumers use persisted delivery or recovery state, while ephemeral events only wake them.
invariants.activates_when: events or notifications can affect correctness

invariants.statement: Material data, operation progress, operation terminal state, and connectivity or authentication are distinct publication classes.
invariants.activates_when: events invalidate reads or update user-visible operation state

invariants.statement: Equivalent intent coalesces, and concurrency, memory, network, provider, and queue use are explicitly bounded.
invariants.activates_when: work can repeat, fan out, or consume shared resources

invariants.statement: Activities holding scarce runtime resources are admitted against protected reserves, have one owning lifecycle, and complete or cooperatively yield within a bounded deadline; required control-plane progress is never reclaimed for optional work.
invariants.activates_when: runtime activities contend for scarce memory, buffers, peripherals, sockets, task capacity, or another resource whose exhaustion can block required progress

invariants.statement: Presentation owns rendering and transient interaction, not retries, synchronization, imports, provider polling, or durable workflow state.
invariants.activates_when: an interactive client exists

invariants.statement: Every important surface has an explicit useful-paint graph; optional enrichment loads and fails independently.
invariants.activates_when: a user-visible surface performs asynchronous reads

invariants.statement: Interactive persistence receives priority, while noninteractive work is bounded, observable, and yields between committed units.
invariants.activates_when: interactive and background work share a non-preemptible resource

invariants.statement: Durable operations capture stable account or tenant authority at admission and fence every commit, acknowledgment, and publication.
invariants.activates_when: active authority can change while work is in flight

invariants.statement: Source observations, canonical state, projections, caches, transport objects, and persisted records remain distinct representations with explicit owners.
invariants.activates_when: one fact has more than one representation

invariants.statement: Absence is not deletion; destruction requires an explicit lifecycle event such as a tombstone, erasure, or verified lossless migration.
invariants.activates_when: state is synchronized, imported, repaired, or migrated

invariants.statement: Persistent, wire, event, storage, and worker contracts are versioned; temporary compatibility names consumers, proof, telemetry, and a removal gate.
invariants.activates_when: independently deployed readers and writers coexist

invariants.statement: Identity, time, units, provenance, capability, and privacy are validated boundary types rather than conventions hidden in strings.
invariants.activates_when: ambiguous primitives cross a trust or representation boundary

invariants.statement: Humans and agents use one discoverable operational interface; machine configuration is local and secrets remain in credential systems.
invariants.activates_when: the repository has repeated build, test, migration, repair, or release actions

invariants.statement: Implementation, integration, metadata change, deployment, installation, migration, repair, and publication are distinct authorization scopes; one explicit instruction may authorize any named combination, while a narrower request never implies a broader action.
invariants.activates_when: work can mutate shared or external state

invariants.statement: Claims bind to exact revisions and evidence classes; generated, simulated, automated, physical, and production observations never substitute for one another.
invariants.activates_when: a result gates integration, release, compatibility, safety, or physical behavior
